question: Do US common stocks whose quarterly revenue and net income improved year over year, and whose price reaction to the information was weak, earn SPY-relative excess returns after costs over 5/21/63 sessions, reproducibly in development and holdout?
observed_before_freeze: prevalidation coverage counts only. No event table, reaction value, quantile, forward return, cohort outcome or feature distribution was computed.
llm_use: PROHIBITED for any alpha, scoring, approval or ranking

data.submissions_merge: per CIK, union of filings keyed by accessionNumber
data.ticker_change_snapshots: all CS_*.json.gz under data/runtime, ordered by date
data.benchmark: SPY from the same grouped store

universe.rows: type CS with non-empty CIK, primary_exchange in XNYS, XNAS, XASE
universe.price_filter: unadjusted close on the signal-formation session >= 5.00 USD
universe.liquidity_filter: median close*volume over the 20 sessions ending at the signal-formation session >= 5,000,000 USD (reused from strategy_e_v1_1 daily eligibility); fewer than 20 sessions -> excluded
universe.ticker_mapping: start from the 2024-10-25 ticker; when it has no grouped row on a session, look up the same CIK in the newest CS snapshot dated on or before that session; if a different ticker is found and has a grouped row, continue on it from that session; record TICKER_CHANGED
universe.dedup: one event per (CIK, filingDate); earliest accessionNumber
universe.signal_eligibility: signal-formation session >= 2024-10-25 (the universe snapshot date); earlier signals -> EXCLUDED_PRE_UNIVERSE_SNAPSHOT, counted, never in any cohort or cutoff
universe.share_classes: when one CIK maps to several snapshot tickers, use the ticker with the highest 20-session median dollar volume ending at the signal-formation session (ties -> alphabetical)
universe.no_backfill: no earlier universe snapshot is reconstructed or used (CS_2024-10-01, CS_2024-10-21 are not read)

event.diagnostic_form: 10-K exactly, annual YoY, never aggregated with primary
event.signal_formation_session: first XNYS session strictly after filingDate; information usable at its close
event.entry: OPEN of the session after the signal-formation session (no same-close entry)

fundamentals.as_known: every value is taken from rows with filed <= event filingDate; when several rows exist for the same period, the one with the latest filed <= event filingDate
fundamentals.current_period_10q: fact rows with accn == event accession and duration 80..100 days; latest end
fundamentals.current_period_10k: fact rows with accn == event accession and duration 350..380 days; latest end
fundamentals.prior_period: same tag, end 365 +/- 20 days before current end, duration within 15 days of current duration
fundamentals.tag_rule: first tag in order that has both current and prior; unit USD
fundamentals.F_plus: FUNDAMENTAL_VALID AND prior Revenue > 0 AND current Revenue > prior Revenue AND current Net Income > prior Net Income
fundamentals.missing: NOT FUNDAMENTAL_VALID -> excluded from F_plus, F_minus, cutoffs and every cohort; reasons counted: XBRL_MISSING, INVALID_FILING_MAPPING, REVENUE_MISSING, REVENUE_PRIOR_MISSING, NET_INCOME_MISSING, NET_INCOME_PRIOR_MISSING, INVALID_PERIOD
fundamentals.FUNDAMENTAL_VALID: current Revenue, prior-year comparable Revenue, current Net Income and prior-year comparable Net Income all present under the tag/period rules AND period/comparability validation PASS
period_validation: event accession has at least one us-gaap fact row (else INVALID_FILING_MAPPING)
current row: accn == event accession, unit USD, duration 80..100 days, latest end
current end < event filingDate and filingDate - current end <= 180 days (else INVALID_PERIOD)
prior row: same tag and unit, filed <= event filingDate, end 365 +/- 20 days before current end, duration within 15 days of current duration
Revenue and Net Income are evaluated independently (each picks its own first tag that has both current and prior)

reaction.anchor: nearest preceding 8-K whose items contain 2.02, same CIK, filingDate in [event filingDate - 60 calendar days, event filingDate]; ties -> earliest accessionNumber; none -> the 10-Q itself
reaction.start: close of the last XNYS session strictly before the anchor filingDate
reaction.terciles: q33/q67 computed once on all DEVELOPMENT primary events passing universe filters and evaluable (F_plus and F_minus together); frozen and reused unchanged for HOLDOUT
reaction.missing: start or end close unavailable for the mapped ticker -> REACTION_UNAVAILABLE, excluded, counted; not part of the tercile population
reaction.tercile_population: DEVELOPMENT 10-Q events passing PIT, universe, price, ADV, FUNDAMENTAL_VALID (F_plus and F_minus together) and reaction available
reaction.ties: WEAK = reaction <= q33 inclusive; MIDDLE = q33 < r <= q67; STRONG = r > q67
reaction.freeze: cutoffs written once to h_n1_dev_reaction_cutoff_v1.json with the contract canonical checksum and its own digest before any forward price is read; never recomputed; HOLDOUT rows are never passed to the quantile function

returns.definition: h sessions counting the entry session as 1; exit at the CLOSE of session h; stock = exit_close_adj / entry_open - 1
returns.split_adjustment: for each split with execution_date in (entry session, exit session]: exit price *= split_to/split_from
returns.excess: stock return - SPY return over the same entry-open to exit-close window
returns.net: excess - cost, deducted once per event
returns.eligibility: an event enters horizon h only if the exit session h exists in the price store (<= 2026-10-12)
returns.delisting: no grouped row for the (mapped) ticker on any session from some session s <= exit through the last store session -> DELISTED_BEFORE_HORIZON; OBSERVED variant = last available close; CONSERVATIVE variant = stock return -100%
returns.other_gap: missing exactly on the exit session but present later -> use the next available close, flag EXIT_GAP
returns.overlap: each event is an independent observation; 63D diagnostic reports the share of windows containing the next 10-Q of the same CIK and the result truncated at that filing's signal-formation close
returns.window_benchmark: SPY return from the entry-session open to the close of the session whose stock close is used (EXIT_GAP: the later session); delisted OBSERVED: SPY to the horizon exit session (proceeds held as cash)
returns.ticker_continuity_in_outcome: inside an outcome window the CIK may be followed through any CS snapshot (including ones dated after the session) to find the successor ticker; signal-time filters use only snapshots dated on or before the session; TRUE_DELISTING = the CIK has no grouped row under any mapped ticker from some session <= exit through the last store session
returns.entry_unavailable: no row for the mapped ticker on the entry session or no SPY open -> ENTRY_UNAVAILABLE, excluded, counted

split.DEVELOPMENT: 2024-10-25 .. 2025-12-31 (first valid signal session on or after the 2024-10-25 snapshot; 2024-10-02..2024-10-24 excluded)
split.holdout_rule: nothing may change after holdout is read; changes require H_N1_CONTRACT_V2 evaluated on new data

statistics.bootstrap: block bootstrap, block = ISO week (isocalendar year, week) of the signal-formation session, resample blocks with replacement (count = number of distinct blocks), 10,000 resamples, numpy.random.default_rng(20261019), 95% percentile CI (2.5, 97.5) of the pooled mean net excess
statistics.season: calendar quarter of the signal-formation session

sample.INSUFFICIENT: PRIMARY N < 100 in a split for that horizon

per_horizon_pass_all: DEV and HOLDOUT: mean net excess at 25 bp > 0 (OBSERVED delisting variant)
DEV and HOLDOUT: median net excess at 10 bp > 0
DEV: bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of mean net excess at 10 bp > 0
DEV and HOLDOUT: CONSERVATIVE delisting variant mean net excess at 10 bp > 0
DEV and HOLDOUT: top 5 events < 50% of the summed net excess at 10 bp, and mean net excess at 10 bp after removing the top 1% of events > 0
ALL SEASONS (DEV+HOLDOUT): mean net excess at 10 bp > 0 in at least 60% of seasons with N >= 30
DEV and HOLDOUT: mean excess at 0 bp of PRIMARY > mean excess at 0 bp of CONTRAST
shorter-horizon consistency: 5D none; 21D requires DEV and HOLDOUT 5D gross (0 bp) mean excess >= 0; 63D requires DEV and HOLDOUT 5D and 21D gross (0 bp) mean excess >= 0 (PRIMARY, OBSERVED variant)
gates.H_N1_PASS: 21D or 63D satisfies every per_horizon condition with sample OK
gates.BORDERLINE: 21D or 63D has positive mean net at 25 bp in both splits but fails CI, concentration, season, contrast, delisting sensitivity, or has WEAK_SAMPLE
gates.FAIL_SIGNAL: DEV mean excess at 0 bp <= 0 at 5D, 21D and 63D
gates.FAIL_COST_BOUND: some primary horizon has DEV mean at 0 bp > 0 but no horizon has DEV mean net at 25 bp > 0
gates.FAIL_HOLDOUT: DEV passes for a horizon but HOLDOUT mean net at 25 bp <= 0 for it
gates.INSUFFICIENT: PRIMARY N < 100 in either split at 21D and 63D
gates.delisting_consistency: all per-horizon gates are evaluated twice, once with the OBSERVED and once with the CONSERVATIVE delisting variant (gate 4 is CONSERVATIVE in both); a horizon can PASS only if both evaluations pass; if they differ the horizon cannot PASS

definitions.sample_ok: PRIMARY N >= 300 in DEV and in HOLDOUT for that horizon
definitions.concentration: denominator = sum of net excess at 10 bp over all PRIMARY events of the split; if <= 0 the gate fails; top5 share = sum of the 5 largest net values / denominator; top 1% removed = drop ceil(0.01*N) largest net values
definitions.season: calendar quarter of the signal-formation session, DEV and HOLDOUT pooled, only seasons with N >= 30; zero eligible seasons -> fail
definitions.dev_passes_for_FAIL_HOLDOUT: every DEV-side condition of gates 1-5 and 7 holds for that primary horizon
definitions.final_line: FAIL_SIGNAL, FAIL_COST_BOUND, FAIL_HOLDOUT and FAIL report as FAIL

prohibited_after_freeze: changing universe, filters, tags, YoY rules, F_plus definition, reaction window, anchor rule, tercile cutoffs, horizons, costs, split dates, gates
adding feature combinations or cohorts as PRIMARY
promoting a diagnostic cohort to PRIMARY after results
runtime, scheduler, API, UI, paper broker before H-N2 PASS
separation: legacy Strategy H forward ledger is LEGACY_FORWARD_EVIDENCE and is never read by H-N1
checksum_recipe: sha256 of json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)
phases: PHASE 1 event construction: no forward price, no quantile
PHASE 2 DEV cutoff: q33/q67 from DEV rows only, frozen file
PHASE 3 forward outcomes: only after the contract checksum and the cutoff digest verify

amendments.title: universe snapshot / DEV start
amendments.effect: signal >= 2024-10-25; earlier -> EXCLUDED_PRE_UNIVERSE_SNAPSHOT; DEV shortened; no extra universe reconstruction

amendments.title: FUNDAMENTAL_VALID / F+ / F-
amendments.effect: F- = FUNDAMENTAL_VALID and not F+; missing/invalid data never F-

amendments.title: shorter-horizon consistency
amendments.effect: 21D needs 5D gross >= 0 both splits; 63D needs 5D and 21D gross >= 0 both splits

amendments.title: delisting sensitivity consistency
amendments.effect: OBSERVED vs CONSERVATIVE disagreement -> no PASS for that horizon

amendments.title: implementation clarifications
amendments.effect: quantile method, ties, share classes, benchmark window, outcome ticker continuity, bootstrap RNG, concentration and season edge cases; no threshold, horizon, cost or filter value changed
